[img]https://img.litet.net/logos/OriginalDescription.png[/img] [h1][b]Farm ressources with RimApps ![/b][/h1]
Make [b]Followers[/b] by creating and posting content on different platforms : [b]RimTube, RimTwich, RimTify, RimBook and RimHub.[/b] Use those followers to build [b]Ad Servers[/b] that will grant you ressources regularly.
There are five different servers to build, each one giving you different ressources.
[h2][b]RimTube Ads[/b][/h2] Gives you [b]plasteel[/b] every 15 days. [h2][b]RimTwich Ads[/b][/h2] Gives you [b]uranium[/b] every 15 days. [h2][b]RimTify Ads[/b][/h2] Gives you [b]steel[/b] every 15 days. [h2][b]RimBook Ads[/b][/h2] Gives you [b]silver[/b] every 15 days. [h2][b]RimHub Ads[/b][/h2] Gives you [b]gold[/b] every 15 days.
Each [b]Ad Server[/b] comes in three different versions : [b]Basic, Intermediate, Advanced.[/b]
Higher techs are available through researches. Higher servers version means more ressources received.
Followers can also be bought (like irl, yeah i know reality sucks) from the [b]Followers Trader.[/b]
Hope you enjoy it. Now go make money !
[b]Stokovski[/b]
My other mod here : [url]https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=1951086368[/url]

[*] Always post your log using the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2873415404]Log Uploader[/url] [*] For best support, please use the Discord-channel for error-reporting. [*] Do not report errors by making a discussion-thread, I get no notification of that. [*] If you have the solution for a problem, please post it to the GitHub repository.
